response.sql:
WITH country_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.birth_country,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM player_college pc
  INNER JOIN player p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(record_count) as total_records,
    AVG(record_count) as avg_per_country
  FROM country_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.record_count,
    cc.record_count::NUMERIC / (SELECT total_records FROM stats) as country_share,
    (SELECT avg_per_country FROM stats) as avg_per_country
  FROM country_counts cc
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    record_count,
    country_share,
    avg_per_country,
    record_count::NUMERIC - avg_per_country as excess
  FROM shares
  WHERE record_count > avg_per_country
)
SELECT 
  SUM(record_count) as total_record_count,
  AVG(country_share) as average_share,
  AVG(excess) as average_excess
FROM filtered

assumptions.assumption: Players with NULL birth_country are included in the grouping and treated as a single country group. The request does not specify whether to exclude or separate NULL values.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude records for players with NULL birth_country from all calculations, counting only countries with explicit birth_country values.
